caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden cabinet with two front doors, rendered in shades of deep reddish-brown. The cabinet sits on small, minimally ornate bracket feet at the bottom corners. Both doors feature recessed panels bordered with a simple, fine decorative trim. The top of the cabinet has a prominent, overhanging cornice with layered molding. A small brass or gold-colored keyhole or escutcheon is visible near the middle of the right door. The background is plain off-white, with faint pencil or ink outlines framing the cabinet, emphasizing its central placement in the composition. The drawing shows careful attention to the texture and grain of the wood, using darker and lighter colors to indicate depth and shadow.
title: Wardrobe
